title: In the living room
descriptionFa: وسایل اتاق نشیمن، و کارهایی که اونجا انجام می‌دیم.

words.example: Three people can sit on this sofa.
Grandpa always sits in his favourite armchair.
Bring a chair and join us.
We have dinner at the table every evening.
Put your tea on the coffee table.
All the furniture in our flat is new.
words.tipFa: غیرقابل‌شمارشه: The furniture is new، نه furnitures. یه دونه‌ش: a piece of furniture.

words.example: The carpet covers the whole floor.
words.tipFa: carpet کل اتاق رو می‌پوشونه؛ rug کوچیک‌تره.

words.example: We have a beautiful Persian rug in front of the sofa.
Close the curtains. The sun is in my eyes.
words.tipFa: پرده رو open یا close می‌کنیم.

words.example: Can you open the window? It's hot in here.
There's a picture of the Caspian Sea on the wall.
The light in the hall doesn't work.
There's a tall lamp next to the sofa.
The light switch is next to the door.
Is there a socket near the bed? I need to charge my phone.
What's on TV tonight?
words.tipFa: کاملش television هست. «توی تلویزیون» می‌شه on TV.

words.example: Where's the remote control? I want to change the channel.
My father still plays his old records on the hi-fi.
words.tipFa: کلمه‌ی قدیمی‌ایه؛ امروز بیشتر speakers می‌گن.

words.example: The phone is ringing. Can you answer it?
We need a new bookshelf for all these books.
I'm reading a good book about Iranian history.
We watch the news every evening.
words.tipFa: watch TV، نه watch at TV. (watch اسم هم هست: ساعت مچی)

words.example: I listen to the radio in the car.
words.tipFa: همیشه با to: listen to music، نه listen music. t خونده نمی‌شه: «لیسِن».

words.example: My son likes to read before bed.
words.tipFa: گذشته‌ش هم read نوشته می‌شه ولی «رِد» خونده می‌شه.

words.example: Turn on the light. It's dark in here.
words.tipFa: switch on هم همین معنی رو داره. ضدش: turn off / switch off.

words.example: Can you pass me the remote control?
